$comment: Which settings sections to replace with the incoming ones — modelled on a browser's 'clear browsing data' dialog: one tick per section, everything visible at once, one button to go. The document holds the frame; the rows (one per section both sides changed) are built by the code into the `Sections` stack at show time, because their number and their words come from the two files compared. The code also decides two visibilities: Compare is only offered when there is somewhere to go, the backup note only said on a path that took one.
